title: Punjab Local Government Twelfth Amendment Ordinance 1999

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Local Government Twelfth Amendment Ordinance 1999
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE L OF 1999
ORDINANCE L OF 1999
PUNJAB
LOCAL GOVERNMENT (TWELFTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
1. Short
title and commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be
called the Punjab Local Government (Twelfth Amendment) Ordinance, 1999.
(2) It shall
come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the day the
Punjab Local Government (Twelfth Amendment) Ordinance, 1999 (XXX of 1999)
stands repealed under Article 128(2) of the Constitution..

2.
Amendment of section 141 of Ordinance VI of 1979.‑‑In the
Punjab Local Government Ordinance, 1979 (VI of 1979) in section 141‑‑
(i) section
141 shall be re‑numbered as"141(1)"; and
(ii) the
following subsection (2) shall be added:‑‑
"(2)
The Government may confer the powers to effect recovery under subsection (1) on
such persons as it may deem fit."
